entities.name: MurE (EC 6.3.2.13)
observations: 494-aa query matches reviewed Vibrio parahaemolyticus MurE at 65.9% identity and 100% query coverage; function is inferred by homology, not direct query-species annotation.
MurE ligase domains are detected at residues 27–103, 116–317, and 340–466.
Reference MurE catalyzes ATP-dependent addition of meso-diaminopimelate to UDP-MurNAc-L-Ala-D-Glu; reaction requires Mg2+.
Reference annotations place MurE in the cytoplasm and link it to peptidoglycan biosynthesis, cell division, and cell-shape regulation.

entities.name: Peptidoglycan synthesis
observations: MurE adds meso-diaminopimelate to the UDP-linked precursor during bacterial peptidoglycan biosynthesis; linked downstream roles include cell division and cell-shape regulation.

entities.name: Bacterial cytoplasm
observations: Reference homologs are annotated as cytoplasmic; this is a homology-based localization assignment for the query sequence.
